items.title: P-type semiconductor ka banna (print mein 2.11.1) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the topic printed as 2.11.1 under 2.10, printed page 42.

blocks.text: Teen valence electrons wale impurity atoms, jaise aluminium, khalis semiconductor mein dale jate hain aur un mein se kuch crystal mein silicon atoms ki jagah le lete hain. Woh silicon atoms electrons ki kami ki wajah se chaar bandhan nahi bana sakte, to crystal lattice mein holes ban jate hain, jo musbat charge carriers ka kaam karte hain. Yeh positive-type (P-type) semiconductor banata hai. Bairooni current source ke electrons is mein se holes mein kood kar guzar sakte hain, to yeh conductor ki tarah kaam karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Boron ki configuration 2, 3 hai. Wazahat karein ke silicon ko boron se dope karne se p-type semiconductor kyun banta hai.
blocks.explanation: Boron us jagah sirf teen valence electrons lata hai jahan chaar bandhan chahiyein, to ek bandhan bina electron ke reh jata hai: ek hole. Holes musbat charge carriers ka kaam karte hain, aur jis semiconductor ki conduction holes par munhasir ho woh p-type hai.

items: Trivalent impurities (Al, B) silicon atoms ki jagah le kar bandhan kam chhorti hain, holes banati hain, musbat carriers: p-type semiconductor jo source se jorne par conduct karta hai.
